analogy.rationale: Cardiomyogenesis inducers act on developmental/differentiation pathways that are largely inactive in these proliferating cancer and immortalised cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest reference classes are other differentiation/developmental modulators (TGF-beta, HDAC, PPAR, retinoid) and angiogenesis inhibitors, but none share a strong downstream program.
